card.name: Next word in step-by-step handling instructions
card.fires_on: Words that continue a numbered instruction step about handling objects, such as a verb's particle or preposition after a thing (cap, vial, tube, deck) or the middle of a word in a procedure.

modes.label: Particle after object
modes.description: A small word like off, from, to, or using follows a handled object in an instruction.

modes.label: Inside procedure words
modes.description: Partway through a word in lab or injection steps, such as saline or syringe.
modes.example: Add 1.5 mL of 0.9% Na<< Cl>> and re-suspend the WBC button

modes.label: Verb or ending in steps
modes.description: A verb or word ending in a practical how-to step.
modes.example: The implant should be inserted subderm<<ally>> just under the skin
